title: blackout.set
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). Starts or ends a communications blackout. While active, phones show static instead of consoles and HUD, the host sends no console.telemetry, flight.hud or pilot.hud, and the server discards any that arrive. Minigames (MG-25) still run.

cause.description: Cause while active; null when not active.

expectedEndAtMs.description: Server clock when the host expects it to end, for the phone countdown; null when unknown or not active. The real end is the next `blackout.set`.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
